column1: # The rules that the files of the design pack own, as data.
# Grove's `plugins/grove/conformance/rules.tsv` states the five tab-separated
# columns: rule, owner, class, load and phrase. Grove's
# `docs/specs/external-pack-contract.md`, "Conformance", states what a run
# checks with this manifest alone and in the aggregate with core.
# Each owner is a file that this pack ships. A rule ID is unique across this
# manifest and every manifest that a run supplies. The conformance runner reads
# only `skills/`, so no row has an owner in `craft/`.
# The last row pins a citation of a craft skill. `grove-design/SKILL.md` names
# the `codebase-design` skill and states what binds without it. Grove's
# `docs/specs/pack-membership.md`, "The Grove tests that name moving kinds",
# moved that row here from the citation registry of Grove's
# `crates/grove/tests/plugin_fallback.rs`.
